serialization_semantics: Resolve root with pathlib.Path.resolve(); raise ValueError unless it is a directory; root mode and root name are not hashed.

Walk with os.walk(root, followlinks=False); at each visited directory filter exact names .git, __pycache__, and .pytest_cache from dirnames, sort retained dirnames, and use that sorted list as traversal order.

Before files at each visited directory, for each retained sorted child directory reject a symlink, then append b"dir\0", the UTF-8 bytes of its root-relative POSIX path, b"\0", ASCII b"mode=" plus stat.S_IMODE(path.stat().st_mode) formatted as lowercase octal without a prefix, and b"\0".

Sort filenames; skip a filename ending exactly in .pyc or .pyo; for each retained filename reject a symlink, then append b"file\0", the UTF-8 bytes of its root-relative POSIX path, b"\0", the same ASCII mode framing, b"\0", its raw path.read_bytes() bytes, and b"\0".

Directory entries, including empty retained directories, are fingerprinted from their parent; ignored directories and their contents and ignored-suffix files are not fingerprinted, which is why the mandatory prehash gate rejects their presence.
Any symlink encountered as a retained directory or file raises ValueError; the prehash gate additionally rejects symlinks, special entries, and all paths outside the exact manifest before hashing.
Return hashlib.sha256 over that exact ordered byte stream as a 64-character lowercase hexadecimal digest.
hash_lock_contract.two_party_rule: The distinct v3 lock producer and the mechanical admission/subject operator each invoke mdseval.hashing.tree_sha256 directly through the identical bound argv, cwd, exact replacement environment, Python bytes, hashing.py bytes, and v3 root bytes; neither may substitute a shell, shasum serialization, file-list digest, reimplementation, or precomputed value.
